checkboxes.description: ORM model defined for 'tools' with correct fields and types matching test specifications

evidence.reasoning: Complete ORM model for 'tools' defined with all required fields: id, name, description, vendor, website_url, category_id, monthly_cost, active_users_count, owner_department, status, created_at, updated_at
evidence.snippet:
model tools {
  id                 Int                    @id @default(autoincrement())
  name               String                 @db.VarChar(100)
  description        String?                @db.Text
  vendor             String?                @db.VarChar(100)
  website_url        String?                @db.VarChar(255)
  category_id        Int
  monthly_cost       Decimal                @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  active_users_count Int                    @default(0)
  owner_department   tools_owner_department
  status             tools_status?          @default(active)
  created_at         DateTime?              @default(now())
  updated_at         DateTime?              @updatedAt

evidence.reasoning: Field types correctly match test specifications: Decimal(10,2) for monetary values, Int for counts, String/VarChar for text fields with proper length constraints, DateTime for timestamps, and enums for status and department

  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
